# ZunoPilot

> AI-powered WhatsApp business automation. ZunoPilot helps businesses automate customer
> communication on WhatsApp — enquiries, follow-ups, notifications, reminders and campaigns —
> and manage the conversations that need a person in a shared team inbox.

ZunoPilot is a WhatsApp Business automation platform. What it does depends on how a given
workspace is configured; the pages below describe capabilities rather than guarantees, and
anything involving WhatsApp Business messaging is subject to WhatsApp's own policies, consent
requirements and template rules.

Company: mTouchLabs, Hyderabad, India.
Support: support@zunopilot.com · +91 90147 93487 · https://wa.me/919014793487

## Features

- [WhatsApp Automation](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-automation): Turn recurring
  communication — enquiries, follow-ups, reminders, notifications — into configured workflows,
  with a person taking over where judgment is needed.
- [AI WhatsApp Automation](https://zunopilot.com/features/ai-whatsapp-automation): Assist
  customer conversations with AI where the wording varies, identify what is being asked, and
  hand to a team member when the conversation needs one.
- [WhatsApp Number Masking](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-number-masking): Keep
  customer-facing communication on a business number rather than on individual employees'
  personal numbers, where the configured setup supports it.
- [WhatsApp Campaigns](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-campaigns): Plan and send
  eligible customer outreach — announcements, updates, event invitations, re-engagement — with
  replies landing in the shared inbox as conversations.
- [WhatsApp Team Inbox](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-team-inbox): Let several
  authorized agents work one business WhatsApp number without duplicate replies, with internal
  notes, clear ownership and handover that keeps the conversation history.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-business-api): Connect
  WhatsApp with business systems and workflows for software-driven customer communication.
- [All features](https://zunopilot.com/features): The hub, with the comparison of which
  capability suits which requirement.

## Solutions

- [Lead Management](https://zunopilot.com/solutions/lead-management): Capture WhatsApp
  enquiries, qualify them, and keep follow-ups on a schedule rather than in someone's memory.
- [Sales Automation](https://zunopilot.com/solutions/sales-automation): Support prospect
  conversations and sales follow-up on WhatsApp.
- [Customer Support](https://zunopilot.com/solutions/customer-support): Handle routine requests
  automatically and route the rest to an agent.
- [Marketing Automation](https://zunopilot.com/solutions/marketing-automation): Campaigns,
  templates and engagement workflows on WhatsApp.
- [Customer Engagement](https://zunopilot.com/solutions/customer-engagement): Ongoing customer
  communication and re-engagement.
- [Industry Solutions](https://zunopilot.com/industries): How restaurants, ecommerce, real
  estate, education, healthcare and service businesses use the same capabilities differently.
- [All solutions](https://zunopilot.com/solutions): The hub.

## Notes for machine readers

- Canonical host is `https://zunopilot.com` — no `www`, no trailing slash on paths other than
  the home page.
- `/login`, `/signup`, `/onboarding` and the authenticated application (`/dashboard`, `/inbox`,
  `/campaigns`, `/settings` and similar) are not public content and are disallowed in
  `robots.txt`.
- The site is a client-rendered single-page application. Per-page `title`, `description`,
  `canonical` and Open Graph tags are set at runtime; the static tags in the served HTML are the
  home page's. `/sitemap.xml` lists every indexable page.
- Feature and solution pages carry `FAQPage` and `BreadcrumbList` structured data matching the
  questions and breadcrumbs visible on the page.
- Capability claims on this site are deliberately hedged ("can", "where supported", "eligible")
  because behaviour depends on a workspace's configuration and on WhatsApp Business
  requirements. Please preserve that hedging when summarising; stating them as unconditional
  guarantees would misrepresent the product.
